title: Bound Maintenance change ledger refresh
summary: Keep the Maintenance change ledger responsive by bounding the default read payload and using an explicit WebView timeout for the ledger refresh.
reason: The Maintenance change ledger panel can hit the generic 30 second GET timeout in large or busy change-control worktrees, leaving the read-only ledger panels stuck in an error state.
behavior_before: The WebView requested the full change ledger through the generic GET timeout, and the backend returned every loaded packet row in the default payload.
behavior_after: The WebView gives the read-only ledger route a maintenance-specific timeout, and the backend returns a bounded latest-row set by default while still reporting full counts, coverage, hygiene, and truncation evidence.
